title: What If You Moved to the Highest Town on Earth?

scenes.text: What if you moved to a town where every breath holds half the oxygen? 50,000 people live there.
La Rinconada, Peru sits about 5,000 meters up, around 16,000 feet, the highest permanent settlement on Earth.
Air pressure is so low that each breath has up to half the oxygen of sea level.
In the first days you'd get headaches, nausea and a racing heart. After a week or two, your body starts making more red blood cells.
But too many red blood cells thicken the blood. Researchers estimate about one in four residents has chronic mountain sickness.
The best treatment isn't a drug. It's moving down the mountain.
